newsitem.title: HONG KONG: APP Global Finance increases FRN to US$638 mln.
newsitem.headline: APP Global Finance increases FRN to US$638 mln.

text.p: APP Global Finance III Cayman Ltd's floating rate note issue has been increased to US$638 million from US$500 million due to oversubscription, arranger Peregrine Fixed Income said.
The facility has a final maturity of five years with no put or call options. The issue was priced at par to float at 425 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 465 basis points.
The issue already had been increased once, to US$500 million from the US$400 million offered at its launch in mid-March.
The further increase in subscriptions came after New York-listed Asia Pulp and Paper announced fourth-quarter 1996 results last Thursday.
The results showed an improvement over the company's third-quarter performance. APP recorded impressive profits in 1995 but faced a tough year in 1996 as pulp prices fell.
The APP Global Finance III notes are secured by a pledge of shares in APP Finance Mauritius that can be exchanged into preferred shares of Asia Pulp and Paper.

Peregrine also said that Sumitomo Finance (Asia) has joined Agricultural Bank of China, IBJ Asia, LG Merchant Bank, OCBC, Sime International and United World Chinese Commercial Bank as a co-arranger in the transaction.
